C1774.title: Bypassing Cloudflare WAF via Request Body Size Limits
C1774.summary: Security researchers found that Cloudflare's WAF only inspects the first 8 KB (free plan) or 128 KB (enterprise plan) of an HTTP request body. Attackers can exploit this behavior by sending oversized requests that hide malicious payloads in the uninspected portion, effectively bypassing WAF detection.
